config.group_rule: Connected components of exact-vector matches and same-class adjacent timestamp links <= gap_ms, computed on ALL original rows.
config.deduplication: Keep first sample in stable class/filename order for each single-label exact vector; exclude all rows of conflicting-label exact vectors.
config.assignment: First fold of shuffled StratifiedGroupKFold(5,42) is test. First fold of shuffled StratifiedGroupKFold(4,43) on remaining groups is validation. No score-dependent search.

note: Group integrity takes priority over exact proportions. Groups are timestamp proxies, not signer/session identities.
